description: Reverse a reversible executed proposal: deletes the real artifact the execution created — the alert rule (create_alert) or the briefing notification (briefing) — and records a feedback memory so the agent learns to be more conservative next time. WRITE. NOTE: an irreversible SOL wallet_transfer is on-chain and cannot be undone — the server rejects that with `irreversible`; to send value back you would have to execute a new transfer. Returns the updated proposal (status → undone) and trust.

agentId.description: UUID of the agent that owns the proposal. Must be an agent owned by the credential.

proposalId.description: UUID of the executed proposal to undo.

name: undo_action
title: Undo a reversible autopilot action
